```{r}
library(auk)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

if (!exists("params")) {

suf=1
```

## Enter file names for the observations and sampling data:

```{r}
samplFile <- "data/ebd_LA_data/ebd_LA_2015-2025_all_spp_sampling.txt"
obsFile <- "data/ebd_LA_data/ebd_LA_2015-2025_all_spp.txt"


## This is where the filtered data will be saved to:
samplOut <- "data/ebd_LA_filtered.txt"
obsOut <- "data/ebd_LA_filtered_sampling.txt"
# obsFile <- "data/ebd_LA_data.zip"
# obsData <- read_ebd(unz(obsFile))

```

## Input your filter values. 

These are the species you can choose from:

### Location

Input the range of latitudes/longitudes, or leave as is to use all data from the state.

```{r}
# lonRange <- c(-94, -89.2) # Louisiana
# latRange <- c(29, 33.5) # Louisiana

## Cropping the map doesn't entirely work...
lonRange <- c(-94, -89.2) # South Louisiana
latRange <- c(29, 31) # South Louisiana

countrySelect <- c("US") ## country code
countryFull <- c("United States of America")
stateSelect <- "LA"   ## state code
stateCode <-  paste(countrySelect, stateSelect, sep="-") 

```

### Species

```{r}
# sppSelect <- c("Wilson's Plover")
# spName <- "Wilson's Plover"  ## this name is for the plot legend
sppSelect <- c("Yellow-throated Warbler","Common Yellowthroat")
spName <- "Warbler"  ## this name is for the plot legend
```

### Date

Leave as is if not filtering by date.

```{r}
dateStart <- "2015-01-01"
dateEnd   <- "2025-01-01"
```

## Filter both datasets.

If the filter looks correct, type "Y" at the prompt to get R to apply it and then combine the two datasets (type ?semi_join in the console to see what it does) to get rid of any checklists that don't appear in both places. 

```{r}

auk_ebd(file=obsFile, file_sampling=samplFile) |>
  auk_date(date=c(dateStart, dateEnd)) |>
  auk_species(species=sppSelect) |>
  auk_bbox(bbox=c(lonRange[1], latRange[1],lonRange[2], latRange[2])) |>
  auk_complete() |>
  auk_filter(file=obsOut, file_sampling=samplOut, overwrite=TRUE) 
  
```

# CREATE DETECTION/NON-DETECTION DATA

## Import the filtered data:

```{r}
obsData <- read_ebd(obsOut)
samplData <- read_sampling(samplOut)
print(str(obsData)) ## view a summary of the dataframe
sppSci <- sapply(sppSelect, function(x) unique(obsData$scientific_name[obsData$common_name==x]))
```

Why does the sampling dataframe have so many more rows than the observation dataframe?

## Zero-filling

To make these data into detection/non-detection data, we need to zero-fill them. Recall what zero-filling does from lecture. We end up with a column "species_observed", which has values of TRUE or FALSE.

```{r}
det1 <- auk_zerofill(obsData, samplData, collapse=TRUE)
rm(obsData)
rm(samplData)
```


## Calculate time variables (might take a while).

```{r}

det <- det1 |> 
  # rowwise() |>
  mutate(
         start = as.POSIXct(paste(observation_date,time_observations_started, sep=" "), tz="America/Chicago"), 
         end   = start + minutes(duration_minutes),
         year  = format(start, "%Y"),
         month = format(start, "%b"),
         date  = format(start, "%d-%b"),
         yearDay  = format(start, "%j")#,
        #  sunr  = getSunlightTimes(observation_date,latitude,longitude,tz=timeZone)$sunrise,
        #  minPastSunrise = as.numeric(round(difftime(start, sunr, units="mins")))
  ) 
```

## Calculate effort variables.

```{r}
# function to convert time observation to hours since midnight
time_to_decimal <- function(x) {
  x <- hms(x, quiet = TRUE)
  hour(x) + minute(x) / 60 + second(x) / 3600
}

det <- det |> 
  mutate(
    # convert count to integer and X to NA (ignore warning "NAs introduced by coercion")
        #  count_chr = observation_count,
    observation_count = as.integer(observation_count),
    # effort_distance_km to 0 for stationary counts
    effort_distance_km = if_else(protocol_type == "Stationary", 
                                 0, effort_distance_km),
    # convert duration to hours
    effort_hours = duration_minutes / 60,
    # speed km/h
    effort_speed_kmph = effort_distance_km / effort_hours,
    # convert time to decimal hours since midnight
    hours_of_day = time_to_decimal(time_observations_started),
  ) 
```

## Filter effort to get better comparisons.

```{r}
det <- det |>
    filter(protocol_name %in% c("Stationary", "Traveling"),
         effort_hours <= 6,
         effort_distance_km <= 10,
         effort_speed_kmph <= 100,
         number_observers <= 10)
det <- det |>
  select(checklist_id, observer_id, scientific_name,
         observation_count, species_observed, 
         state_code, locality_id, latitude, longitude,
         protocol_name, all_species_reported,
         observation_date, year, yearDay,
         hours_of_day, 
         effort_hours, effort_distance_km, effort_speed_kmph,
         number_observers)

```

# MAP THE DETECTION DATA

## Create map of the area you specified above (either latitude/longitude box, or state(s))

Prepare the GIS data & the observations:

```{r}
landMap <- read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_land") |> 
    st_geometry()
riverLines <- read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_rivers") |> 
    st_geometry()
stProvBound <-  read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_state_lines") |> 
      st_geometry()
ctryBound <- read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_country_lines") |> 
      st_geometry()
stateArea <- read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_states") |> 
  # filter(state_code %in% stateCodes) |>
  filter(state_code == stateCode) |>
      st_geometry()

```

```{r}
# table(det$scientific_name, useNA="ifany")
# det3 <- det |> filter(is.na(observation_count))
sppLevel <- c("none", "S.dominica", "G.trichas", "G.trichas&S.dominica" )
if(length(sppSci)>1){
  det2 <- det |>
    mutate( sci_name = sub("^(\\w)\\w*\\s+(\\w+).*", "\\1.\\2", scientific_name, perl = TRUE)) |>
    ## NA just means no count, so count it with "present"
    mutate(species_name = ifelse(is.na(observation_count) | observation_count>0,sci_name,"")) |>
    # mutate(species_name = na.omit(if_else(is.na(observation_count) | observation_count>0,NA_character_,sci_name))) |>
    # mutate(species_name = ifelse(observation_count>0,paste(scientific_name, collapse="_"),"")) |>
    group_by(checklist_id) |>
    # print(species_name)
    mutate(
      # species_present = ifelse(species_observed==FALSE, "none", paste(species_name, collapse=" "))
      species_present = ifelse(species_observed==FALSE, "none", paste(species_name[nzchar(species_name)], collapse="&"))
      # species_present = ifelse(species_observed==FALSE, "none",toString(species_name[nzchar(species_name)]))
      # species_present = case_when(species_observed==FALSE ~ "none",
    #                               scientific_name==sppSci[1] ~
      ) |>
    mutate(species_present=factor(species_present,levels=sppLevel)) |>
        ungroup()
    #   )# |>
    # mutate()
    # ))
    # select(species_observed, scientific_name) |> 
    print(table(det2$species_name, useNA="ifany"))
    print(table(det2$species_present, useNA="ifany"))
    print(table(det2$observation_count, useNA="ifany"))
}

bbox1 <- st_bbox(c(xmin=lonRange[1],xmax=lonRange[2],ymin=latRange[1],ymax=latRange[2]), crs=st_crs(4326))
detections_sf <- det2 |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |> 
  # st_crop(xmin=lonRange[1], xmax=lonRange[2], ymin=latRange[1], ymax=latRange[2]) |>
  st_crop(bbox1) |>
  select(species_present)

## Optional: save to file so you can load it more quickly in future
if (FALSE){
  st_write(detections_sf, "data/det.gpkg")
}
```

```{r}
if (!exists("detections_sf")) detections_sf <- read_sf("data/det.gpkg")
# bbox <- bbox1 * rep(c(1.0005, 1.00005), 2)
bbox <- bbox1 
xlims <- c(bbox[1], bbox[3])
ylims <- c(bbox[2], bbox[4])
bbox_w <- (bbox$xmax - bbox$xmin)
bbox_h <- (bbox$ymax - bbox$ymin)
# bbox_asp <- (bbox$ymax - bbox$ymin) / (bbox$xmax - bbox$xmin)
bbox_asp <- bbox_h / bbox_w
```

### PLOTTING

Customize the plot colors and text:

```{r}

colorList <- c(
  # "S.dominica" = "#dfbe08",
  "S.dominica" = "#fcb721",
  # "G.trichas" = "#b6b315",
  "G.trichas" = "#eeeb42",
  "G.trichas&S.dominica" = "#369733",
# noColor = "#998585"
  # "none" = "#e3e5ec"
  # noColor = "#807474"
  "nondetect" = "#7a767c"
)
stateColor <- "#d7dae0"
grpLabels <- c("S. dominica", "G. trichas", "Both", "Neither")
# grpLabels <- c("*S. dominica*", "*G. trichas*", "Both", "Neither")
dir.create("out") ## will warn if already exists; you can ignore
now <- format(Sys.Date(),format="_%d-%b")
plTitle <- ""
print(levels(detections_sf$species_present))
```

We will plot the non-detections as a separate layer to be sure our detection points plot on top.

```{r}
fname <- sprintf("out/occurrence_map_%s%s.png", suf, now)
# sppPlot <- ggplot(detections_sf) +
sppPlot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=landMap, fill = "#b9bbc2") +
  geom_sf(data=stateArea, fill = stateColor) +
  geom_sf(data=stProvBound, color = "#ffffff") +
  geom_sf(data=ctryBound, color = "#ffffff") +
  geom_sf(data=riverLines, color = "skyblue2") +
  geom_sf(data=filter(detections_sf,species_present=="none"), aes(color="nondetect"), size=0.1, alpha=0.1) +
  geom_sf(data=filter(detections_sf,species_present!="none"), aes(color=species_present), size=0.2, alpha=0.3) +
  coord_sf(xlim=xlims, ylim=ylims, expand=FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "eBird detections",values=colorList, labels=grpLabels) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha=0.6))) +
  theme(
        legend.background = element_rect(fill=stateColor),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "skyblue", color = NA)
    # plot.background = element_rect(fill = "navy", color = NA)
  )

ggsave(fname, plot=sppPlot)

suf <- suf+1
```
